hero.name: Delvalle Fernando
hero.desc_1: I build products with real depth.
hero.desc_2: I lead a freelance team where technical criteria <br className="fd-hero--br" /> matters as much as business vision.

about.quote: "The best way to predict the future is to create it."
about.description: A software developer with a passion for technology and innovation. I enjoy building practical, efficient, and scalable solutions, always focused on improving the experience of the people who use them. I'm driven by new challenges, process optimization, and continuous learning — growing both technically and creatively.
about.text_1: Founder and Tech Lead of Utterly, my own development team. I'm involved in the entire lifecycle: from planning, interviews, documentation, and design, to Full Stack development and production deployment.
about.text_2: I manage and operate my own server. Having this infrastructure allows me to spin up agile demo environments and maintain a constant, direct workflow and communication channel with my team.
about.text_3: I bring a product-oriented mindset focused on delivering business value at a technological level for new clients, while also offering the engineering rigor and corporate software practices needed to integrate meaningfully into enterprise environments.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Technologies, tools, and languages I use in real projects.

services.p1_desc: Building resilient, interactive user interfaces using React, Next.js, and modern CSS architecture. Focus on performance, accessibility (a11y), and pixel-perfect implementation of complex design systems.
services.p2_desc: Designing scalable microservices and robust REST/GraphQL APIs. Leveraging Node.js, PHP, and relational databases to ensure data integrity and seamless communication between services.
services.p3_desc: Bridging the gap between design and engineering. Deeply experienced in crafting highly immersive web experiences using GSAP, Framer Motion, and WebGL for standout marketing pages.
services.p4_desc: Building cross-platform applications with native-level performance for both mobile devices and desktop environments.
services.p5_desc: Technologies I'm actively expanding my expertise in. Constantly pushing to broaden my stack and stay at the cutting edge of modern development.

cta.subtitle: Currently available for freelance opportunities and leadership roles.

otter.title: Otter Task
otter.subtitle: v.1 - MVC Panel
otter.description: Business management system for organizing stock, sales, and purchases. Developed with PHP and MySQL following MVC architecture. Deployed on custom infrastructure with Nginx and Ngrok for collaborative development.

otter-v2.title: Otter Task
otter-v2.subtitle: v.2 - React Migration
otter-v2.description: Migration and modernization of Otter Task to SPA architecture. Frontend completely rewritten in React consuming a RESTful PHP API. Includes new features: ticket generation, QR system, improved sales modal, and more professional workflows. Deployed on custom infrastructure with Nginx and Ngrok.

cpa.title: CPA Refrigeration
cpa.subtitle: Panel + Mobile App
cpa.description: Comprehensive system with a mobile app for refrigeration technicians and a web admin panel. Allows recording technical visits, equipment status, incidents, and generating reports. Developed as a team, leading the technical implementation of the React frontend integrated with a PHP REST API. Deployed on custom infrastructure.

cpa-desinfeccion.title: CPA Disinfection
cpa-desinfeccion.subtitle: Angular Legacy Support
cpa-desinfeccion.description: Maintenance and evolution of a 5-year-old legacy system with a mobile app and web panel in Angular, and a Node.js API. Updated obsolete libraries, fixed critical bugs, implemented new features, and refactored complete modules. Team work acting as tech lead.

mottoso.title: Mottoso Properties
mottoso.subtitle: Full Real Estate Platform
mottoso.description: Complete real estate platform with a property catalog for buying and renting, valuation system, interactive map integration, contact forms, and admin panel. Developed as a team with React and PHP. Deployed on custom infrastructure with Nginx.

beretta.title: Beretta Logistics
beretta.subtitle: Transport Control
beretta.description: Logistics control panel for a freight transport company. Vehicle fleet management, maintenance history, route planning, fuel control, employee administration, and access role system. Developed as a team with React, PHP, and Tailwind CSS. Led the project's technical architecture.

lithos.title: Lithos
lithos.subtitle: Tattoo Publisher
lithos.description: Advertising page for a tattoo studio that allows clients to learn more about the studio and book appointments online.

tateti.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
tateti.subtitle: Classic Game
tateti.description: Implementation of the classic tic-tac-toe game with a modern interface and smooth animations. Developed in React to practice state management and game logic.

portfolio-v.1.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio-v.1.subtitle: First Version
portfolio-v.1.description: My first personal portfolio developed in React. A learning project that allowed me to experiment with animations and visual effects, though it had performance issues that motivated this new version you're viewing.

otter-solutions.title: Otter Solutions
otter-solutions.subtitle: Corporate Portfolio
otter-solutions.description: Professional portfolio for Otter Solutions, a software development team where I act as tech lead and developer. Site designed to showcase our services and collaborative projects. Developed in React with a modern and responsive design.

sassa.title: Sassa
sassa.subtitle: Financial Landing Page
sassa.description: Promotional landing page for a financial application. Developed with WordPress and Elementor, focused on conversion and attractive visual design.

tattoo.title: Tattoo Sizer
tattoo.subtitle: Tool for Tattoo Artists
tattoo.description: Web application for tattoo artists that simplifies template printing. Allows grouping multiple images in A4 format and adjusting dimensions based on 300 DPI. Developed with vanilla JavaScript and the Canvas API. One of my first commercial projects.
